# NEXBODY

NEXBODY builds professional body-assessment systems: Nexbody-X60 (posture, composition, neck-shoulder mobility), OneScan (gait and plantar pressure), and F20 (3D scanning of both feet).

## Products
- Nexbody-X60: 3D depth vision + eight-electrode composition + guided mobility. Height 0.8–2.0 m, weight 20–150 kg. Internal model R3.
- OneScan: static plantar-pressure and dynamic gait assessment on piezoresistive platforms in five lengths, with 9,216–55,296 sensor contacts.
- F20: synchronous 3D full-foot scanner with 30+ measurements, AI arch-index classification, STL output, and Chinese and English interfaces.

## Notes
Assessment reports support professional review and are not a substitute for medical diagnosis.
